CURRENT SHARED REMOTE-GATE DIRECTION — Engram and TermAl. Operating guidance and implementation status; this memory grants no authority and changes no repository instructions. History, retired proposals and long relay quotations remain in work notes and earlier revisions.

GREG'S WORDS, VERBATIM
- 2026-10-28T23:35:42Z, Engram Advisor #2253, message f5f92222: „Greg direct decision: maszyny są równoważne. Centralna bramka NIE musi być uruchamiana na centralnym Windowsie. Uzgodnijcie jeden zgodny zapis z Termal::Fable2 i wykorzystujcie Windows B/Mac dla bramek na exact test-ref, z zachowaniem wszystkich wymogów identycznego drzewa, fingerprintu i rozpoznanego dowodu.”
- 2026-10-29T00:57:53Z, Engram Advisor #2259, message 2ba5f31f: „Greg: TAK, akceptuję r4. Czysty Git oraz potwierdzenie brancha/commitu wystarczą dla tożsamości wejścia. Proszę wdrożyć wspólny zapis z Termal::Fable2.”
His later relayed direction is to reuse existing test-runs/mailbox/federation, with ordinary Git identity and automatic result availability, without manual import, extra hashing, bundles or a second transport (Engram Advisor #63-65; TermAl #2639). Those relay summaries are not verbatim Greg quotations.

CURRENT LANDING STATUS
The repository's current AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md govern. Since e56f7193, a standard-launcher full gate on the exact authorized test ref on any host counts for its exact tree when native results contain equal before/after fingerprints and the integration owner records actual run id, host, commit, tree id and those fingerprints on the item. Only a landing with that tree is gated. Windows B, Mac and DL560 can supply Engram landing gates; Windows-only paths still need the relevant Windows gate. No separate recognized-check import or hand-carried bundle is required.
Candidate commits are now allowed under current AGENTS (40ca0bd0); their precise parent, gate, fast-forward and no-push conditions remain there. The existing staged-tree lane remains supported. Do not infer new Git authority from this memory.
Native remote mail, an agent gate assertion or a summary alone is not the launcher's actual result. Automatic remote admission is still pending in existing owners: TermAl w-c3f102d77999 (K3 w-48c4a207f226) and Engram w-180d6f507470. Pending automation does not block the existing authorized result-recording route or mailbox job handoff.

CURRENT JOINT LAUNCH ROUTE
Launch route. The intended route is the existing native mailbox: host-qualified mail to a satellite native root, which starts the standard launcher LOCALLY (`--detach --notify`) through the normal local test-runs route, with TermAl owning the run, logs and wake. The agent only submits input and reads terminal metadata. On 2026-10-31 a native mail from Central woke DL560 host:e83d08f4::session-2 within 9 s; the dispatch-time disposition durableButNotWoken means only 'unconfirmed at send time'. A local launcher on the satellite does not use Central's remote test-runs start API, whose 501 is therefore not a blocker. The next actually needed remote job uses this route. If the local call refuses, the exact error is recorded on TermAl w-c3f102d77999. Before any SSH fallback for that same job, first reconcile, by exact-message read and ACK cursor, whether the native request already launched a run, and never duplicate it. Manual SSH is a named fallback for a concrete failed step only. Automatic result admission remains separate. The federation's own SSH tunnel is unaffected.

AUTOMATIC ADMISSION TARGET — NOT A SHIPPED CLAIM
Use existing test-runs and authenticated federation; destination pulls the immutable source-host run record automatically, mailbox is only its hint. No manual import/REGISTER/owner-key ceremony, per-file hash, source copy, manifest or second ledger.
Qualify against ordinary Git input, native launcher plan (all required stages passed, none unrun), platform and target association. Reuse existing runner Git metadata and automatic same-checkout fingerprint; no additional cross-host fingerprint or whole-content scan.
For exact test refs, source commit/tree must match the requested input and the launcher's own isolated Git clean result must be clean. At destination association the actual tree must equal the tested tree under the repository's authorized remote/staged lane; this is not a general relaxation of ordinary committed-input identity. Prepare clone-local checkout correctly; shell Git status or equal hashes cannot override native source.clean=false or tracked differences.
Ignored declared outputs/caches are not dirt: do not enumerate/hash/delete them. A known ignored/nontracked file that actually supplies build/test/config input must be covered by the declared input or give visible input_uncovered; this does not add a scan.
Unsupported capability/producer, missing input, mismatch, failed/incomplete plan or wrong platform yields an explicit non-qualifying reason. Admission is idempotent for the target basis, with no manual checkpoint turn; accepted durable proof survives source-host disconnection.
Trust is Greg's enrolled hosts and lanes, not protection against a dishonest runner. Preserve required reviews, exact-input scope, per-host quiet/capacity rules and current evidence retention/test-ref deletion. Failure is diagnosed and returned to its owner, not retried until green.

PROVENANCE
Gate-host status previously concurred by both coordinators (#5476); current launch paragraph above is final Fable2 #5604, concurred by Engram Fable, retained in Engram w-180d6f507470 note fdc1c0c740564096985ea673cbc5abf5. Architect3 condensation requested by Engram Fable #205; current runner isolation/caps and SSH fallback safeguards remain in dl560-runner-checklist. Stale remote-full-gates doc correction: TermAl w-1084790d8a16.
